body:
Your ask (31 Oct): cozy spots, no cages.
- Floor 1: dog naps on the sofa, cat on the window seat, bunny + hamster on the play hill.
- Floor 2: capybara in the warm tub, duck on the pond, owl on its branch.
- Floor 3: bear on the sofa watching TV, seal slides into its pool, monkey on the climbing frame.
Uses the Living chat's new sit and lie poses.

comments.text:
Done: all 9 spots; an independent check found no big problems.
Leftovers: owl perch inside the leaves, seal bigger than its slide, monkey head brushes the bar.

Updated: owl on its new perch, seal uses the bigger pool and slide.
Same moves, new models.

short: Nine shop pets, each at its own spot. OK?
source: Model movements 31 Oct: asks from the Objects chat
title: Pet Shop: pets at their cozy spots
